subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about driving validated web sales for {Brand} on a cost-per-sale basis. The one point worth repeating: the commission triggers only on a completed Canadian order that survives your returns window, read through your web pixel and a server-to-server postback that passes the click ID and order ID, so the payout is already return-adjusted and you never pay twice for demand you already own. At the throughput we run, that lands near 5,000 validated web sales a day. Want me to pull the category-level sales view for Canada?
angle: warm bump, restate validated web sale proof
illustrative_flags: 5,000 validated web sales a day (MobUpps, illustrative)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN ecommerce CPS: references prior outreach in first sentence; restates single proof (validated web sale, return-adjusted, S2S postback with click ID + order ID); one illustrative MobUpps figure (5,000 validated web sales/day); soft CTA, exactly 1 question mark; no sign-off; native business English (Canada, no transliteration); no em-dash, no X-not-Y.
